shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true
rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | sed -n '1,160p'
rg -n \"beforeSession|afterSession|onError|specs/hal-engine-config-hooks|CHANGELOG\" src specs CHANGELOG* .lore 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,240p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
git log -5 --oneline --decorate
sed -n '1,230p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
sed -n '1,130p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
sed -n '1,80p' CHANGELOG.md
cat package.json
sed -n '1,200p' .lore/test-commands.yml"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts -t "runs onError before afterSession when it throws"'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts -t "runs onError before afterSession when it throws"'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md
nl -ba specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | sed -n '20,34p'
git diff --check
git diff --stat
git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts -t "runs onError before afterSession when it throws"'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && git commit -m "fix: run lifecycle hooks when beforeSession fails" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
